title: Hardcore Punk
tagline: Speed, volume, and urgency stripped down to the essentials.
summary: Hardcore punk pushed punk rock into a sharper, faster, more confrontational form. It favors relentless drums, distorted guitars, and lyrics that feel blunt and immediate. In a short span, scenes spread across the United States and beyond, with each location adding its own sense of style, attitude, and community.

pillars.name: Black Flag
pillars.why: Black Flag weaponized speed and tension, making hardcore a demanding, confrontational sound.

pillars.name: The Ramones
pillars.why: The Ramones kept the energy direct and immediate, influencing how fast and blunt hardcore could be.

pillars.name: Minor Threat
pillars.why: Minor Threat's clarity and aggression defined a compact, high-intensity hardcore identity.
